A suspect catches his pants on a fence and is caught; a vehicle is stopped for false registration and failure to maintain lanes; an unwelcomed family member is charged with throwing a deadly missile through a window and criminal mischief.
A suspect tries to flee; several drug dealers try to slip through the cracks; a known drug user denies that he tried to pawn his baby for crack; an officer questions a suspicious pair at a park.

A detective intervenes in a chaotic fight; suspects are arrested for dealing cocaine out of their grandmother's house; a disturbed father claims he accidentally fired off five rounds inside his house; a couple argues.
An officer stops a car passenger from reaching for his gun; officers seek a couple involved in a bar fight; a motel vandal is unaware of his surroundings; officers deal with Mardi Gras.

A suspect leads police on a dangerous chase through a neighborhood; a prowler claims he was at the wrong address; a man's wild imagination causes him to make threats; police clean up a massive car wreck.

A car chase suspect can't explain his passenger's motives for taking over his vehicle; a driver uses medicinal marijuana as an excuse to avoid charges; police grab a burglar out of an attic; a female driver gives false information.

A little person challenges an officer; police settle a violent fight between two combatants from different generations; a passionate kiss is the cause of a hit-and-run accident; father and stepson have a fight.
A driver's getaway gets a flat tire; after a high-speed chase, a suspect barricades himself in his own bathroom; a broken windshield and a kick to the stomach are the result of a dispute.
